clips.title: The story
paras: Brewnall Village sits in Chill Breeze Valley, near the entrance to Gnomeregan. The Barleybrew family keeps this dwarven camp for brewing experiments and defense against wild beasts.

Brewnall Village shelters the Barleybrew clan in Chill Breeze Valley, among the gnomish reaches of western Dun Morogh. The dwarven brewers work to perfect old recipes and make the finest stout. Tents and brewing gear fill the camp, with no permanent stone buildings. The Barleybrews test new ales while wolves and bears threaten the valley. Wandering mountaineers help gather rare ingredients and keep the area safe.
